# Bug: Race condition in multi-threaded counter

## Description
The shared counter implementation has a race condition when multiple threads increment concurrently. Final count is often incorrect.

## Expected Behavior
With 10 threads each incrementing 1000 times, final count should be 10,000.

## Current Behavior
Final count varies between 8,000-10,000 (non-deterministic).

## Root Cause
The increment operation (read-modify-write) is not atomic. Multiple threads can read the same value, increment it, and write back, causing lost updates.

## Proposed Solution
Use thread-safe primitives (Lock, atomic operations, or thread-safe data structures).
